text:
rachel park: Quick sync — final checklist for the marketplace launch thread. Need confirmation on: press embargo timing, partner assets, localized landing copies, SI provisioning runbook, and dry-run slot.

maria chen: Ill coordinate legal for embargo. Proposed embargo: Fri 08:00 PT (partners preview), public Fri 16:00 PT. Legal wants final announcement copy 24h prior.

noah green: Growth prefers public publish at 16:00 PT to hit EU morning. We need UTM template from marketing: utm_source=partner&utm_medium=marketplace&utm_campaign=launch_v1. Also confirm CTA variants (try/learn).

samir patel: Hardware partners (EdgeAccel, RackX) delivered imagery + badges. Uploading to /shared/partners/marketplace_assets now. I'll also attach a 2-line partner quote file. SI team: terraform snippets for tenant provisioning coming by 3pm.

maria chen: Two small asks from legal: (1) partner quotes must be pre-approved in writing, (2) embargo list should be segmented (press-only vs partner comms).

rachel park: Noted. Can press ops run the segmented list? Also need localized landing copy: EN freeze by tomorrow noon, locales by Wed EOD.

press-ops-bot: dry-run-scheduler: dry run proposed: 2026-05-08 09:00 PT. Confirm participants: rachel park, samir patel, legal, SI lead, press ops.

noah green: For marketplace metadata (AWS/Azure/GCP) I'll add the fields mapping in a doc: long description, 3 bullets, pricing snippet, SLA blurb, partner contact. Will PR to content repo tonight.

samir patel: SI note: SSO mapping is the biggest friction. I'll include SAML attribute map + sample terraform for tenant creation. Will post to runbook and tag @jen on-call for validation.

maria chen: If legal signoff misses the 24h window we push embargo to Mon 07:00 PT. Keep me posted on partner quote approvals.

rachel park: Action summary:
```
- Freeze EN landing copy: rachel/noah -> tomorrow 12:00 PT
- Localizations: localization team -> Wed EOD
- Upload partner assets (SVG, 2x PNG, quotes): samir -> today 3pm (/shared/partners/marketplace_assets)
- Legal signoff on announcement & quotes: maria -> 24h prior or fallback
- SI runbook + terraform + SAML map: samir -> today 5pm
- Dry run: press-ops-bot -> 2026-05-08 09:00 PT
- UTM + CTA mapping: noah -> PR tonight
```

noah green: I'll also add tracking ids for the partner badges to capture referral conversions.

samir patel: Uploaded assets and initial runbook link: /shared/partners/marketplace_assets (files: edgeaccel_quote.txt, rackx_cta_assets.zip, si_runbook_draft.md).

maria chen: Legal received drafts, doing reviews now. I'll ping here when signed. :white_check_mark:
